The Biden DOJ spent its time targeting President Trump and working with the SPLC.

Under President Trump, the DOJ is arresting gang members and illegal aliens.
God bless the Justice Department and AG Blanche for doing what the Democrats won't: protect American lives.
ICE doing their jobs despite Democrat resistance.

Democrats create sanctuary jurisdictions to protect criminal aliens.

Why won't they protect American lives in their cities and states too?

Fund the police.

Honor the fallen.

And always Back the Blue.

Arrests are up.

Crime is down.

All thanks to President Trump's leadership.
Democrats are more worried about moms saying things they don't like at school board meetings than criminal aliens hurting Americans.

A former Biden official admitted what we knew all along.

The Biden-Harris Administration relied on the SPLC's "extremism" materials.

What groups are extremists to the SPLC?

-Moms for Liberty

-Family Research Council

-Alliance Defending Freedom

Crazy.

Congratulations to these Bellefontaine students!

All of Ohio is rooting for you at the National Junior Achievement Titan Challenge.

Strong April jobs report.

Added 115,000 new jobs — nearly double expectations.

President Trump's economy is working.

Murder victim’s mother to testify before Congress on Fairfax’s immigration policies
